avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces dexamethasone levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or monitor for reduced corticosteroid effects

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May stimulate immune system, potentially counteracting immunosuppressive effects of dexamethasone
avoid_supplements.action: Advise patient to discuss with prescriber before use

caution_supplements.name: Licorice Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mineralocorticoid activity may potentiate sodium retention and hypokalemia risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor electrolytes and blood pressure if concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance hyperglycemic effects of dexamethasone

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor may increase dexamethasone concentrations and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products from diet during dexamethasone therapy

caution_foods.name: High Sodium Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Dexamethasone increases sodium retention; excess intake potentiates fluid retention and hypertension
caution_foods.action: Recommend moderate sodium restriction; monitor blood pressure

caution_foods.name: High Glycemic Index Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Dexamethasone impairs glucose metabolism; high-GI foods worsen hyperglycemia
caution_foods.action: Emphasize low-GI carbohydrates and monitor blood glucose

caution_foods.name: Calcium-Rich Dairy (Excess)
caution_foods.mechanism: Dexamethasone impairs calcium absorption; high intake may mask bone loss risk
caution_foods.action: Ensure adequate but not excessive calcium; supplement vitamin D

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood glucose, electrolytes (especially potassium), blood pressure, and bone health during dexamethasone therapy. Assess for drug interactions with CYP3A4 inducers/inhibitors and counsel on immunosuppression precautions.
